description: This Java source file defines the JobPoller class, which manages job queuing and execution within the OFBiz framework. It includes thread pool management, job scheduling, and configuration listening functionalities.

classes.name: JobPoller
classes.description: Main class managing job polling, thread pool, and job queueing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JobInvokerThreadFactory
classes.description: Thread factory for creating threads in the job execution pool.

classes.name: JobManagerPoller
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to poll registered JobManagers for jobs to enqueue.

methods.name: createThreadPoolExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures the thread pool executor based on service configuration or defaults.

methods.name: createPriorityComparator
methods.description: Creates comparator to sort jobs by priority and start time.

methods.name: pollWaitTime
methods.description: Retrieves the polling wait time from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: queueSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum queue size from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: registerJobManager
methods.description: Registers a JobManager instance with the JobPoller.

methods.name: getPoolState
methods.description: Returns current statistics of the thread pool and job queue.

methods.name: onServiceConfigChange
methods.description: Updates thread pool settings when service configuration changes.

methods.name: queueNow
methods.description: Queues a job for execution, handling invalid states.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the JobPoller and its thread pool.
